psychological_meaning: Ice Cold evokes feelings of calm, serenity, and cleanliness. It is often associated with clarity, purity, and a refreshing sense of peace. This color can also represent innovation, minimalism, and a modern aesthetic, suggesting a cool and collected demeanor.
